newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Pinto sees 96 profit of 11.5 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Banco Pinto sees 96 profit of 11.5 bln esc.

text.p: Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor said it expected to make a net consolidated profit of 11.5 billion escudos in 19996.
It said the profit would enable the board to pay a dividend of 60 escudos per share. It gave no further details.
Banco Pinto made a net profit of 7.63 billion escudos in 1995 when it paid a gross dividend of 60 escudos per share.
The bank forms part of the Champalimaud group.
Banco Chemical Portugal, recently bought by the group, expected to make a profit of 4.4 billion escudos and pay a dividend of 80 escudos per share, the group said in a statement.
Credito Predial Portugues, also part of the group, expected a profit of 3.7 billion escudos and a dividend of 80 escudos, it said.
